resources.string: Review this blood pressure reading first
Recorded systolic pressure exceeds 180 or diastolic pressure exceeds 120 mmHg. This is not a diagnosis.

If your blood pressure is currently this high with chest pain, breathlessness, back pain, numbness, weakness, vision changes or trouble speaking, contact local emergency services now. Do not wait for Agent.

If this is a current reading without these or other new concerning symptoms, wait at least one minute and measure again. If still this high, contact a health professional as soon as possible. Do not change medication yourself.
This guidance is for nonpregnant adults. Children and pregnancy need different assessment; seek prompt professional advice rather than relying on this cutoff.
Check the measurement date. An old record does not establish a current emergency. The App cannot determine your current symptoms or detect every dangerous condition; no warning does not mean safe.
Source: American Heart Association · reviewed 14 Aug 2025
